stage0030_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We're about to head into space,
　so what's got you upset?」

stage0030_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$正太郎$$... let me handle this」

stage0030_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm training to be a teacher too.
　I'll get $$ブラックオックス#robot$$ to open up somehow」

stage0030_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Hey, $$オックス$$... will you listen to me?」

stage0030_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong?
　Are you feeling ill somewhere?」

stage0030_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$オックス$$... you don't want to listen to me?」

stage0030_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$オックス$$...!
　Even I have a limit to my patience!」

stage0030_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$郁絵$$
「What are $$正太郎$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ doing?」

stage0030_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Not sure why, but for some reason
　$$オックス$$ is in a sulky mood.
　We're trying to figure out why」

stage0030_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$モーム$$
「A belly button!?
　But $$ブラックオックス#robot$$ is a robot, so does
　it have a belly button!?」

stage0030_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$厚井$$
「That's not it, $$モーム$$.
　'Ox is sulking' just means
　he's in a bad mood」

stage0030_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$桂$$
「Huh... so even a robot has moods」

stage0030_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$モーム$$
「Of course, Master $$桂$$!
　$$ブラックオックス#robot$$ may not be able to talk,
　but it really does have a heart!」

stage0030_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$モーム$$
「An insensitive attitude like that
　must be what hurt $$オックス$$'s feelings!」

stage0030_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$厚井$$
「But $c has to leave for
　space soon, and this happens.
　What a bother」

stage0030_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$郁絵$$
「That mysterious explosion at the deep
　space station... so this is $c's
　first sortie」

stage0030_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$木下$$
「A station meant to check conditions
　out in deep space... Takeo General
　Company helped build it, and now it's broken...」

stage0030_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So since it looks suspicious,
　we're being sent out to investigate, huh」

stage0030_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$桂$$
「So you're saying someone might
　have attacked the station...」

stage0030_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$厚井$$
「But if he keeps acting like that,
　we'll have no choice but to leave $$オックス$$ on Earth...」

stage0030_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$柿小路$$
「How about it, $$モーム$$?
　Since you're both robots, could you
　find out what's wrong with $$オックス$$?」

stage0030_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$モーム$$
「Well, it seems someone more suited
　to this than me has just arrived」

stage0030_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「...Now that's no good, $$オックス$$」

stage0030_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
Lorelei
「I'm $$ローレライ・ハインリッヒ$$.
　A robot, just like $$オックス$$」

stage0030_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Though her actual body has been
　sealed away, at her own request」

stage0030_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
Tsubasa
「Pleased to meet you, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　I'm $$錦織つばさ$$, $$甲児$$'s mother.
　Thank you for looking after my no-good son」

stage0030_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$つばさ$$
「I run the $$くろがね屋$$ hot spring inn
　in Atami. I'm here today as $$ローレライ$$'s chaperone」

stage0030_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「I work there too, as it happens」

stage0030_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ローレライ$$ plays the role of $$ブラックオックス#robot$$'s
　big sister. So I'm sure she can
　get him to open up」

stage0030_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「You have to listen to $$正太郎$$ and
　everyone else. Since when did you become
　such an unreasonable child?」

stage0030_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「$$オックス$$!
　What is with that attitude!?」

stage0030_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Not even $$ローレライ$$ can get through...」

stage0030_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「Wait, please, $$正太郎$$.
　I'll try to talk $$オックス$$ around once more」

stage0030_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Give it up, $$ローレライ$$.
　No matter how much you try, it's no use」

stage0030_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$つばさ$$
「$$ブラックオックス#robot$$ has the mind of a three year old.
　This is what they call the terrible twos」

stage0030_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Every kid goes through it.
　No matter what you say, all they say back is no」

stage0030_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Especially since $$オックス$$ is a boy.
　No matter how much you tell him, it's no use」

stage0030_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$甲児$$
「Huh... $$オックス$$ and the terrible twos, huh...」

stage0030_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$タケル$$
「Proof that he's growing up healthy.
　Rough on $$正太郎$$, having to look after him, though」

stage0030_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$静子$$
「That's true.
　Though $$タケル$$'s terrible twos lasted quite a while」

stage0030_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ナミダ$$
「So $$タケル$$ went through
　a phase like that too, huh」

stage0030_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$静子$$
「That's right, $$ナミダ$$.
　And $$タケル$$ couldn't get out of diapers for ages」

stage0030_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「Rare to see you this flustered, $$タケル$$」

stage0030_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Bring up something from my childhood,
　and there's nothing I can do」

stage0030_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$つばさ$$
「It's a bit cruel making $$タケル$$ the only
　one embarrassed. Let's talk about $$甲児$$'s
　childhood next」

stage0030_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Even battle hardened warriors like
　$$甲児$$ and $$タケル$$ are still just kids
　in front of their mothers」

stage0030_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$スズネ$$
（I did hear about $n's father and
　sister, but now that I think of it,
　their mother had passed away too...）

stage0030_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「It's about time to depart.
　Everyone, board the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$」

stage0030_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ケンジ$$, what do we do about $$オックス$$?」

stage0030_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「If he has no will to do this himself,
　we'll just have to leave him be」

stage0030_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$つばさ$$
「You do your best too, $$甲児$$」

stage0030_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$甲児$$
「You be careful of $$あしゅら$$ too, Mom」

stage0030_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「See you, $$オックス$$.
　I'm... done with you」

stage0030_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「So in the end, $$オックス$$ came rushing aboard
　right before we launched?」

stage0030_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「He's just a kid, after all.
　He got anxious once $$正太郎$$,
　his guardian figure, was gone」

stage0030_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Maybe him getting anxious isn't
　just about $$正太郎$$ being gone」

stage0030_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That hangar...
　goes pitch black when the lights go out」

stage0030_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$くらら$$
「You mean $$オックス$$ is scared of the dark?」

stage0030_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Black Ox in the dead of night...
　Isn't that a byword for darkness itself?」

stage0030_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Ridiculous.
　Since when does a robot fear the dark?」

stage0030_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't jump to conclusions.
　It's not the dark itself you fear...
　It's what lurks within it」

stage0030_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$朔哉$$
「If you want to hear something creepy,
　I'll go get $n」

stage0030_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アンディ$$
「No need for that.
　Good timing, I'll tell you all
　a ghost story from $$聖天使学園$$」

stage0030_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「A rumor passed down at Neo-DEAVA,
　about a vanished Element」

stage0030_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アンディ$$
「This was some years back...
　A girl transferred into $$聖天使学園$$」

stage0030_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But her shy nature worked against her,
　and she couldn't make any friends」

stage0030_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Unable to bear the loneliness, she
　vanished from school one day, without a trace...」

stage0030_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Her only friend was a stuffed doll...」

stage0030_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Ever since, a stuffed doll has been seen
　wandering the academy night after night,
　as if voicing the girl's regret...」

stage0030_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アンディ$$
「And they say that doll is always singing,
　in a voice both beautiful and sorrowful」

stage0030_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アマタ$$
「W-wait, $$ゼシカ$$!
　If you cling to me like that...!」

stage0030_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Get off of $$アマタ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!」

stage0030_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sorry, sorry!
　$$アンディ$$'s voice just startled me」

stage0030_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Just so we're clear,
　it's not like I'm scared of ghosts」

stage0030_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Whoa... $$アマタ$$,
　you're the only one floating around」

stage0030_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Just like one of $$リン・ミンメイ$$'s famous songs」

stage0030_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「'0-G Love'!
　Perfect for me and $$ジョニー$$ out here in space」

stage0030_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「We're near where the station was.
　Get ready to launch」

stage0030_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$くらら$$
「Will terrible-twos $$オックス$$ even launch?」

stage0030_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$葵$$
「Who knows...
　I doubt Crusher Team's Captain $$ケンジ$$
　would allow that kind of selfishness」

stage0030_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright!
　We'll give it our all for $$オックス$$'s sake too!」

stage0030_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「By the way, $$アンディ$$... what is that doll?」

stage0030_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa! When did you get there!?」

stage0030_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I've no idea whose it is...」

stage0030_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アマタ$$
「T-the doll left by the rumored
　vanished transfer student...」

stage0030_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Impossible!
　A phenomenon like this can't exist!」

stage0030_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Gravity waves detected
　from the center of that giant thing!」

stage0030_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アルト$$
「Are you saying it's a black hole!?」

stage0030_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That's impossible!
　If a black hole had appeared,
　we'd already be sucked into its gravity!」

stage0030_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I am the ruler of the universe...
　The black hole incarnate, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0030_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Hear me, people of Earth.
　Abandon resistance and surrender at once」

stage0030_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Refuse, and you give up your own lives.
　Decide quickly and surrender」

stage0030_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$葵$$
「That thing...!
　What is it talking about!?」

stage0030_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So it'll kill everyone on Earth
　if we don't surrender...?」

stage0030_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
???
「Like hell I'll listen to that garbage!!」

stage0030_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Does it hurt, $$オックス$$!
　But this time, I'm not holding back!」

stage0030_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're the one it hurts, $$正太郎$$...
　You're punching $$オックス$$ with your bare hands...」

stage0030_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$タケル$$
「Not using $$鉄人$$ there
　is what makes $$正太郎$$ admirable」

stage0030_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why's that?
　I'd think $$オックス$$ would listen better
　if he got hit with $$鉄人$$」

stage0030_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$'s not forcing $$オックス$$ to obey.
　He's showing him he's truly angry」

stage0030_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I get it.
　So basically, he's putting his soul into it」

stage0030_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's the idea.
　This should make $$オックス$$ reflect on what he did」

stage0030_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So in the end... what was $$オックス$$ even sulking about?」

stage0030_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Just something any man would do」

stage0030_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$オックス$$ wanted everyone to recognize
　that he's a man in his own right」

stage0030_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$シモン$$
「But everyone treated him like a kid,
　so he must've gotten sulky about it」

stage0030_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$タケル$$
「So it was terrible twos
　plus a rebellious phase...」

stage0030_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$甲児$$
「Causing everyone trouble
　over something like that...!」

stage0030_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You two must've wanted people around you
　to notice you too, and puffed yourselves up.」

stage0030_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's the truth.
　Just like $$オックス$$ and $$正太郎$$ just now,
　I got yelled at by Bro plenty too.」

stage0030_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シモン$$
「But I think about it now.
　Bro was going all out against me
　because that's how he showed he saw me...」

stage0030_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... that's just like him.」

stage0030_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's just how it is between men.
　So $$オックス$$ will surely take $$正太郎$$'s words
　to heart, honestly.」

stage0030_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Even $$ローレライ$$ or Miss $$スズネ$$
　can't do anything about this one.」

stage0030_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's fine as long as you understand, $$オックス$$.
　Sorry for hitting you.」

stage0030_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$正太郎$$
「And I'm sorry for not noticing
　how you really felt.」

stage0030_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$正太郎$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has finally revealed
　his true form. Now we must fight him.」

stage0030_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm counting on you, $$オックス$$.
　Let's do our best together again, starting today.」

stage0030_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Looks like the case is closed.」

stage0030_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You saved us, $$シモン$$.
　If you all had come any later,
　$$オックス$$ might've been done for.」

stage0030_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let me thank you as well.
　Thank you very much, Mr. $$シモン$$.」

stage0030_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$シモン$$
「No need for thanks.
　We're part of $c too, starting today.」

stage0030_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$葵$$
「But today's $$シモン$$ was so cool.
　It was just like $$カミナ$$.」

stage0030_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$シモン$$
「I still can't match up to Bro.」

stage0030_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...I've never actually met
　this $$カミナ$$, so I wouldn't really know...」

stage0030_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But today, Mr. $$シモン$$ really suited
　being called 'Bro'.」

stage0030_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$葵$$
「Not exiled from the $$暗黒大陸$$ this time, right?」

stage0030_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$葵$$.
　It's the $$新世界大陸$$ now.」

stage0030_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Over on the $$新世界大陸$$,
　$$ロシウ$$'s serving as acting chief.」

stage0030_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Mr. $$シモン$$ and the rest of us
　came here answering the summons
　of $$プリベンター$$'s Commander $$レディ・アン$$.」

stage0030_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「As it happens, I'd just come back
　to the $$新世界大陸$$, so I'm riding
　$$グレンラガン$$ to show my training's results.」

stage0030_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$竜馬$$
「How are $$キタン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$ doing?」

stage0030_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ギミー$$
「$$キタン$$'s assisting $$ロシウ$$,
　and seems to be pretty busy with it.」

stage0030_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ヨーコ$$'s still teaching on the island, as always.」

stage0030_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$シモン$$
「Aren't you going to ask about $$隼人$$ and $$渓$$?」

stage0030_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Knowing them,
　when the time comes, they'll show up
　on their own, even without being called.」

stage0030_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$葵$$
「But I was surprised, you know...
　that $$ダリー$$ and $$ギミー$$'s Gunmen are new models now.」

stage0030_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Me and $$ダリー$$'s Gunmarl
　got rushed into development because $$リーロン$$ said
　future battles would be in space.」

stage0030_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$葵$$
「Space...? Don't tell me that means
　we're going to war with the colonies?」

stage0030_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ダリー$$
「No....
　I think $$リーロン$$ meant fighting enemies
　like the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

stage0030_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Well, whatever.
　No matter what shows up, if it's an enemy of peace,
　we'll just take it on.」

stage0030_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Glad to have you, $$シモン$$.
　This $c is exactly the kind of unit
　you said it'd be.」

stage0030_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$くらら$$
「There's a transmission coming in for $$シモン$$...」

stage0030_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$くらら$$
「I'll patch the line through to you.」

stage0030_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ニア$$
「Looks like you all made it to the rendezvous safely.」

stage0030_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ニア$$
「Seeing your face puts me at ease.
　You suddenly said you were off to space,
　so I was worried.」

stage0030_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'm fine.
　Today too, I gave a good twist
　to some henchman of that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ villain.」

stage0030_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ニア$$
「Please do your best, $$シモン$$.
　And please, come home safe no matter what.」

stage0030_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'll be waiting with a delicious meal ready.」

stage0030_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$くらら$$
「You two are as close as ever.」

stage0030_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$葵$$
「You'd better come back alive from this one.」

stage0030_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$.
　I'll live and come back to you, without fail...）

stage0030_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$リーロン$$
「I hear $$シモン$$ and the others
　made it safely to $c.」

stage0030_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Same silent treatment as ever.
　He's barely spoken since the $$再世戦争$$ ended.」

stage0030_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「So agreeing to send Mr. $$シモン$$ and the others
　to $c were his last words...」

stage0030_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$リーロン$$
「That's the attitude of someone
　who definitely knows something and stays quiet.」

stage0030_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「And we're the ones left unsettled
　by the words he said...」

stage0030_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$リーロン$$
「The enemy is space...
　Once you know about things like that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　you can understand what he meant.」

stage0030_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$リーロン$$
「The problem's the other one, then.」

stage0030_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「The end of the myth...
　What does that mean...?」

stage0030_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Who knows...
　Being no god myself, thinking about it is pointless
　until $$ロージェノム$$ cracks and talks.」

stage0030_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Well... however you look at it,
　it doesn't sound like a fun story...」

stage0030_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「That said, we can't just
　accept our own destruction.
　Whatever it takes, we'll fight with all we've got.」

stage0030_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$リーロン$$
「I know, $$ロシウ$$.
　That's exactly why we sent $$シモン$$ out.」

stage0030_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ロシウ$$
（Mr. $$シモン$$...
　You've always been our hope...）

stage0030_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ロシウ$$
（So, I believe...
　that you and $c
　will overcome every disaster to come...）

stage0030_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I've been waiting for you this whole time!」

stage0030_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$シモン$$
「That robot there is $$ＡＧ$$,
　and that hat over there is $$アンディ$$, right?」

stage0030_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
Andy
「I'm $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!
　True to my name: I've staked my life on digging!」

stage0030_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Ha... said that proudly right to my face, huh.」

stage0030_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シモン$$
「But I'm the man they called Digger $$シモン$$!
　I accept your challenge!」

stage0030_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Just what I wanted!
　Starting today, I'm taking the title
　of $c's number one digger!」

stage0030_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That doesn't sound like a very popular title...」

stage0030_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So then, the contest's fine by me, but
　just where do you intend to dig?」

stage0030_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$シモン$$
「Time and place don't matter for a man's contest!
　Wherever we meet, that's where we settle it!」

stage0030_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Here I gooooo!!
　Burn bright, my Digging Force!!」

stage0030_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh, Master $$ＭＩＸ$$!!
　Please hit me with a Fill!」

stage0030_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, don't worry, the D-Trader will still be open.
　Let's get fired up today too... business, business!」
